blocks.text:
Arrival in Rio de Janeiro.

As your plane descends, you can see the hills, ocean, beaches and dense cityscape.

On arrival, you will be met and transferred to your hotel. Along the way, you can see colonial buildings and the city's famous beaches.

After check-in, you have free time. You can walk along Copacabana's seafront promenade with its distinctive black-and-white mosaic paving.

Your first day introduces you to Rio's beach life: football and volleyball on the sand, the ocean, cafés and the everyday leisure of the city's residents, known as cariocas.

paragraphs.text: Day 4 · After breakfast, a private tour to Corcovado. A specially designed train climbs from the foot of the mountain through the lush Tijuca rainforest, with glimpses of Rio’s tropical wildlife such as toucans and monkeys. At the summit, 710 metres above sea level, stands the iconic 38-metre statue of Christ the Redeemer; but the statue is only part of the experience, as breathtaking panoramas unfold across Rio, from Guanabara Bay and Maracanã Stadium to Sugar Loaf, Copacabana, Ipanema and Gávea. Return to your hotel.
